title: Late binding
code:

for i in range(3):
    fs.append(lambda: i * 10)
print([f() for f in fs])

title: Closure assignment
code:

def f():
    print(x)
    x = 2
f()
out: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'x' where it is not associated with a value

title: Decorator order
Class attribute vs instance attribute
code:
class C:
    n = 0
    def bump(self): self.n += 1
a, b = C(), C()
a.bump(); a.bump()
print(a.n, b.n, C.n)

title: super() follows the MRO
__slots__

s.x = 1
s.y = 2
